title: Seagrove Beach "Chel-SEA Lane Hideaway" 80 Chelsey Lane
h1: Seagrove Beach "Chel-SEA Lane Hideaway" 80 Chelsey Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach- 5 Adult bikes- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day- Low speed vehicle- Deeded beach access- Outdoor cabana/pool space - Ample bunk room space- Near public beach options- Ideally situated on 30A near Seaside; short drives to Alys and Rosemary Beach- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Discover the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern luxury at Chel-SEA Lane Hideaway, a 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Designed to accommodate up to 18 guests, this 2-story home offers a private pool, spacious indoor and outdoor living areas, and thoughtful amenities for a memorable getaway—only a 4-minute bike ride from the beach!From the moment of arrival, the quaint front porch offers a warm invitation to unwind and embrace the laid-back beach vibes. The living area, with its neutral tones, natural textures, and cozy fireplace, creates a welcoming space to relax on the comfy furnishings. Just beyond this is the covered patio with alfresco dining and easy access to the pool. Families will love the bright and airy kitchen with high-end appliances, sleek countertops, and an island with built-in appliances that seats 4—perfect for quick bites or morning coffee. The sunlit dining room, with seating for 12, sets the stage for memorable meals, while the nearby dry bar with a wine and beverage cooler ensures refreshments are always within reach. The first-floor guest bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and separate shower, offering a serene retreat. When it's time to step outdoors, enjoy the private pool with a sun shelf and loungers, a stylish poolside deck featuring a fireplace and cozy seating, and a BBQ grill perfect for poolside feasts.Upstairs, the primary bedroom is a sanctuary of luxury, featuring a king bed, private bathroom with a deep tub and separate shower, and a fully furnished balcony with great views. Three additional guest bedrooms provide ample space for everyone—2 with king beds, private bathrooms, and balcony access, and a bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 1 twin-over-twin bed, complete with a private bathroom.Chel-SEA Lane Hideaway offers on-site parking for 5 vehicles, plus a low-speed vehicle and 5 adult bikes for easy exploration. For beach access, take Elm Street to San Juan Avenue and continue to E County Highway 30A. Turn left onto 30A, proceed to Bramble Grove Place, and Santa Clara Regional Beach Access is on the left. Book today! body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove Beach "Chel-SEA Lane Hideaway" 80 Chelsey Lane Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 10 Sleeps 18 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach - 5 Adult bikes - Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day - Low speed vehicle - Deeded beach access - Outdoor cabana/pool space - Ample bunk room space - Near public beach options - Ideally situated on 30A near Seaside; short drives to Alys and Rosemary Beach - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Discover the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern luxury at Chel-SEA Lane Hideaway, a 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom retreat in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Designed to accommodate up to 18 guests, this 2-story home offers a private pool, spacious indoor and outdoor living areas, and thoughtful amenities for a memorable getaway—only a 4-minute bike ride from the beach! From the moment of arrival, the quaint front porch offers a warm invitation to unwind and embrace the laid-back beach vibes. The living area, with its neutral tones, natural textures, and cozy fireplace, creates a welcoming space to relax on the comfy furnishings. Just beyond this is the covered patio with alfresco dining and easy access to the pool. Families will love the bright and airy kitchen with high-end appliances, sleek countertops, and an island with built-in appliances that seats 4—perfect for quick bites or morning coffee. The sunlit dining room, with seating for 12, sets the stage for memorable meals, while the nearby dry bar with a wine and beverage cooler ensures refreshments are always within reach. The first-floor guest bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom with a deep-soaking tub and separate shower, offering a serene retreat. When it's time to step outdoors, enjoy the private pool with a sun shelf and loungers, a stylish poolside deck featuring a fireplace and cozy seating, and a BBQ grill perfect for poolside feasts. Upstairs, the primary bedroom is a sanctuary of luxury, featuring a king bed, private bathroom with a deep tub and separate shower, and a fully furnished balcony with great views. Three additional guest bedrooms provide ample space for everyone—2 with king beds, private bathrooms, and balcony access, and a bunk room with 2 full-over-full beds and 1 twin-over-twin bed, complete with a private bathroom. Chel-SEA Lane Hideaway offers on-site parking for 5 vehicles, plus a low-speed vehicle and 5 adult bikes for easy exploration. For beach access, take Elm Street to San Juan Avenue and continue to E County Highway 30A. Turn left onto 30A, proceed to Bramble Grove Place, and Santa Clara Regional Beach Access is on the left. Book today!
